get.description: Ensures the CSRF cookie is set (the SPA calls this on startup).

post.description: Queue a database backup now (the worker uploads it to storage).
Cancel waiting jobs. Running ones cannot be interrupted safely and finish their step.

get.description: Sign-ins (successful and failed) of the current user and what happened in each session.
Every matching document, for "select all" across pages (filters only, no text search).

post.description: Upload a PDF from the web UI. Uses the same durable intake and pipeline as scanners.
Queue every document (e.g. overnight, after choosing a new AI model); busy ones are skipped.

delete.description: Put a document in the trash: it can be restored, its files stay. See /alterations/trash.

get.description: The instructions and switches saved as the default for suggestions.

post.description: Start grouping the selected documents into subfolders; poll the result.
Put the given (not yet placed) documents away in this location, in scan order.

put.description: Save the inbox. It brings documents in, so it asks for the password again like other credentials.

post.description: Try the given settings (the saved password if none is given) without saving them.
Ask the AI model for changes to the selected documents; poll the result. Nothing changes by itself.

get.description: Installed models for a review; a mid-sized one (8B) that runs all night works well.

post.description: Let the assistant look through documents — now or later, for hours. It only suggests.
Stop and write the report with what there is (a review that has not started is cancelled).
Remember what the user did with a suggestion (the change itself goes through its own API).
Make page pictures and fingerprints for every document that has none yet.

get.description: A page's picture; `large` renders it big enough to read (slower: from the file).

post.description: Make documents from pages: merge, split, extract, remove or reorder. Originals stay untouched.

EnhanceSettingsIn.description: Partial update: omitted fields keep their current value.
EnhanceSettingsIn.title: EnhanceSettingsIn

AlterationOrigin.description: Which suggestion of the assistant a change came from (shown in the document's history).
AlterationOrigin.title: AlterationOrigin
